title: feat(objectql)!: an agent and a skill hold one name per package (bare-name phase 1, 4/4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XAtn2B9TgkenAcW63kQpRgC)_

Fixes #30803

PR 4 of 4, the last of phase 1's series by type family: PR 1 #30836 (the data family), PR 2 #31006 (the request family), PR 3 #31093 (the flow family), this one the AI family (`agent`, `skill`), per ruling 6688041914. Claim 6716532253 (`domain:server#5`, card-thread session_01FEkQ5pr7Ua2kPRCMZNupZg).

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the engine's package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`) and item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) refuse, after the cold boot, a package registration they accepted before: one whose agent or skill bears a name another installed package holds. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` does not teach that two packages may share an agent or skill name, and the naming rule itself is phase 2's (#30805); the prescription ships in the refusal and warning text and in ADR-0048's 2026-11-06 addendum (P1.9).

⚠️ **Tier H**: this diff touches `docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md` (header, §3.4 note, the addendum's status line, P1.5 and the new P1.9). The seat routes the approver.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：裁决 C 第一阶段的最后一族。冷启动结束后，agent 和 skill 的名字一个部署只认一个包：安装门和注册口拒绝第二个包，422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`，点出两个持有包和改名建议（与 #30836、#31006、#31093 同一机制）。这是该系列的收尾，合并即关闭 #30803。
- 为什么改：实测两包同名、两种注册顺序——`/meta/agent/NAME` 给先注册包的 agent；MCP 客户端按名取 skill 提示词，拿到的是先注册包的 skill（另一个被静默丢弃），`/meta/skill/NAME` 同样；都不告警。启动后再装一个同名包，今天照常 200 并被遮蔽。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄接受集，不改任何已存数据；`tool`、`rag_pipeline` 不在裁决列表里，不受影响。示例应用和平台包都没有声明 agent 或 skill，现有部署不会因此启动失败（冷启动只告警）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`（列表末尾加入 AI 族、两个类型的理由短句）、ADR-0048 P1.9 与 P1.5、`registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts` ——预期 26 passed。
- 需要你做的：ADR 改动是 Tier H，需要审批人批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`** — the covered types grow from ten to twelve: `agent` and `skill` join `BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES` last, as the AI family (`BARE_NAME_REGISTRY_TYPES` stays derived); their collection keys (`agents`, `skills`), consumer clauses and nouns, empty built-in and overridable-baseline sets. Module doc: the two measurements, the family closing the series.
- **`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`**, **`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`** — comments name the twelve types; no code change. Both doors and the cold-boot seal are generic over the list.
- **`packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts`** — its type-list cell now pins its own family's slot (`slice(0, 10)`); the whole list is pinned by the AI family's file.
- **`docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md`** (Tier H) — header Addenda entry and §3.4's 2026-11-06 note name the twelve types and drop "to follow"; the addendum's status line names P1.9 as the last change; P1.5 becomes the series' record ("The series, complete"); new **P1.9** — the measurement, what is refused, what is not in the list (`tool`, `rag_pipeline`), the cold boot, the series' close.
- **`scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__bare-name-one-holder.ts.json`** — the invariant names the fourth family and its served holder.
- **`.changeset/30803-bare-name-ai-family.md`** — `@objectstack/objectql` `minor`, both declaration lines, BREAKING Why / Before / Now / The cold boot / Who moves / Unchanged, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, measured producers.

## Why (measured)

Booted showcase + two `AppPlugin` packages (`com.qa.bare.alpha`, `com.qa.bare.beta`) sharing one name per type, in both registration orders, on `30e0bd16`; then `POST /marketplace/install-local` of a third package (`gamma`) declaring all held names (a temporary dogfood file, deleted):

| Type | Consumer | Served (alpha→beta / beta→alpha) | Warned | Third package after the boot |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `agent` | `GET /meta/agent/NAME` | `alpha` / `beta` — first-registered | no | `200`, shadowed |
| `agent` | kernel `metadata` service (`get('agent', NAME)`, the MCP `agent_prompt` read) | nothing in either order: the service lists no package agent on the composed runtime (ADR-0063 §2) | — | — |
| `skill` | MCP `prompts/get` (`listSkillPrompts` over the merged `GET /meta/skill` list) | `alpha` / `beta` — first-registered; the other row dropped | no | `200`, shadowed |
| `skill` | `GET /meta/skill/NAME` | `alpha` / `beta` — first-registered | no | — |
| `tool` (not in the ruling) | `GET /meta/tool/NAME` | `alpha` / `beta` — first-registered | no | `200`, shadowed |
| `rag_pipeline` (not in the ruling) | — | not declarable: `defineStack` refuses the `ragPipelines` key; nothing registered | — | — |

The agent runtime that resolves an agent or a tool by name for chat lives in objectstack-ai/cloud and is NOT MEASURED here. Both ruled types resolve without package context, so both join the list.

## Verification

At head `15ed46b6` (feat `55c70231` cut on `30e0bd16`, then `origin/main` merged once at `e7354255`: six commits, none in this PR's files, no conflict). The unit and dogfood pins, the gates and the battery ran on `15ed46b6`; the ablation, the typechecks and the full objectql suite ran on `55c70231`:

- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts` (new, 26 cells, real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`): the type list (all twelve, in family order) and the two labels; `declaredBareNames` over `agents` and `skills` and a nested plugin, a tool declaring nothing; for each of the two types the data family's matrix — package door (both holders, rename, no record left), ABLATION before the seal, item seam, nested plugin, same-package reload (CONTROL), uninstall releases, environment registration never judged and never a holder (CONTROL), the cold boot (warns once naming both and the rename; reload keeps both, a third refused naming both; `'refuse'` refuses with the doors' envelope); CONTROLs — two packages' tools under one name both install after the seal, one package's agent and another's skill under one name never meet; the reason names only the types it carries; a built-in skill name is refused at the package door. With the data, request and flow families' pins and `hook-binder.test.ts`: **5 files / 180 passed**.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts` (new, booted showcase + two `AppPlugin` packages + `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin`): the cold boot boots and logs ONE `WARN` line naming the agent and the skill, both packages and the renames, never the shared tool; `/meta/agent/NAME`, `/meta/skill/NAME` and the MCP skill prompt keep serving `alpha`; `POST /marketplace/install-local` of `gamma` declaring the held agent name and of `delta` declaring the held skill name are each `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` naming both holders and the rename, the package list unchanged; CONTROL: `epsilon` with fresh agent and skill names plus the shared tool name installs, and its agent and skill prompt serve. With the three earlier families' dogfood files: **4 files / 16 passed**.
- Ablation (committed first, through `ablation-replace.mjs`, restored with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty): `agent` and `skill` filtered out of `BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES` (marker `ABL4`) → the AI family's unit file **18 of 26 red** (the list and `declaredBareNames` cells, every refusal at both doors, each ABLATION cell's after-seal half, the cold-boot warn / reload / refuse cells, the reason and built-in cells; the 8 green are, per type, the same-package reload, the uninstall release and the environment CONTROL, plus the tool and agent-versus-skill CONTROLs); objectql rebuilt with the mutation (`ablation-dist-preflight`: marker in 4 built files; the DTS step failed on the mutated literal's type, TS2322, after the JS bundles were written) → the dogfood pin **3 of 4 red** (no warning line; `gamma` and `delta` installed), the CONTROL green. Restored, rebuilt (marker absent from all 14 built files, tree clean) → 4 of 4 green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` exit 0 (incl. `check:test-typecheck`: 39 files / 233 errors / 64 pinned signatures held, unchanged); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec tsc --noEmit` exit 0; eslint (`--no-inline-config`) over `packages/objectql/src` and the dogfood file exit 0, no findings.
- `@objectstack/objectql` full suite under `os-verify-lock`: **568 files / 11516 tests passed** (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` at `15ed46b6` (merge base `e7354255`, 9 paths): 90 derived families, every one run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all 90 exit 0 on the first run (the `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` prerequisites were already built on this worktree); `--ran`: "90 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 90 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED" (exit 0). The gates first ran on `55c70231`; `main` moved during that run, so it was stopped, `main` merged and the whole derived list re-run on `15ed46b6` (the derivation was the same 90).
- Full dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, under `os-verify-lock`) at `15ed46b6`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` · Test Files 438 passed | 3 skipped (441) · Tests 3622 passed | 41 skipped (3663) · no failures (held the lock 1801s on a shared box). Ran because the title carries `!` and `Clause-②` carries the `(narrowing)` arm.

## Kept

- Same-package re-registration, the environment catalog (ADR-0005 overlay), every data-, request- and flow-family pin green unchanged; `tool` and `rag_pipeline` keep §3.4 as written; cold boot stays ruling B (`BARE_NAME_COLD_BOOT_MODE = 'warn'`, untouched).

## Acceptance notes

- `agent`: the open framework's one by-name read of a package agent is `/meta/agent/NAME`. The kernel `metadata` service (what MCP `agent_prompt` reads) lists no package agent at all on the composed runtime; agents are platform-owned (ADR-0063 §2), and the cloud runtime that resolves one by name for chat was not measured. The ruling kept `agent` in this card and the `/meta` door is a by-name read without package context, so it joins.
- `tool`: same first-registered answer at `/meta/tool/NAME`; not in the ruling's nine, so not added (reported to the seat).
- `rag_pipeline`: `defineStack` refuses `ragPipelines` as an unrecognised stack key, though the engine's collection loop and the manifest spelling table still list it; nothing measured beyond that (reported to the seat).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; lint — see Verification.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request (the fourth of a series by type family, per the ruling).
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer brief is in Chinese by the seat's convention).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
